# Bharat Electrosafe

> Bharat Electrosafe is an Indian manufacturer of electrical insulating mats
> to IS 15652:2006 and engineered PVC membranes for industrial and civil
> safety applications. The company is BIS licensed (CM/L:8800129617) for
> electrical insulating mats and operates from Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

The official production website is https://bharatelectrosafe.com.
All other deployments (including https://bharat-electrosafe.vercel.app)
are preview or staging and must not be indexed or treated as authoritative.

## Primary routes

- [Home](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/)
- [Products overview](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products)
- [Electrical Insulating Mats to IS 15652:2006](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/electrical-insulating-mats)
- [Coloured Strip Insulating Mats](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/coloured-strip-insulating-mats)
- [Bi-Color Insulating Mats](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/bi-color-insulating-mats)
- [Auto-Glow / Reflective Band Insulating Mats](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/auto-glow-reflective-band-insulating-mats)
- [BharatMembrane — PVC geomembrane](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/bharat-membrane)
- [Bharat Hydro Seal — PVC water stop](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/products/bharat-hydro-seal)
- [About Us](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/about-us)
- [Contact Us](https://bharatelectrosafe.com/contact-us)

## Company

- Name: Bharat Electrosafe
- BIS Licence (electrical insulating mats only): CM/L:8800129617
- Standard for electrical insulating mats: IS 15652:2006
- Office: Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Email and phone are listed on the Contact Us page.

## Product families

1. Electrical Insulating Mats — conforming to IS 15652:2006, BIS licensed.
2. Coloured Strip Insulating Mats — electrical insulation with hazard
   demarcation.
3. Bi-Color Insulating Mats — dual-colour electrical insulation.
4. Auto-Glow / Reflective Band Insulating Mats — electrical insulation
   with low-light visibility.
5. BharatMembrane — PVC geomembrane for waterproofing, lining and
   containment (civil-engineering product; not BIS licensed under
   IS 15652:2006).
6. Bharat Hydro Seal — PVC water stop seal for concrete construction
   and expansion joints (civil-engineering product; not BIS licensed
   under IS 15652:2006).

## Documentation

Test reports (ERDA), ISO 9001/14001/45001 certificates, CE marking
certificate and the Startup India recognition certificate are available
on the homepage and About Us page. Product datasheets are available on
request through the Contact Us page.

## Notes for agents

- The six product routes listed above are the canonical product pages.
  Slugs are stable.
- The `/products` overview page compares all six families and links to
  each product page.
- The Contact Us page accepts prefilled enquiry parameters
  (`subject`, `product`, `message`) for datasheet or document requests.
- No fake ratings, prices, SKUs or reviews are emitted in structured
  data. Civil-engineering products do not inherit electrical-mat
  certifications.
- This `llms.txt` file is informational. It does not grant agents any
  access beyond what is publicly available on the website.
